label: The engine behind a store
description: What is asked of the engine itself rather than of the records. A startup step reaches ensure through a domain port bound to a data graph, so what a tree prepares is what its project.json says it prepares.

ensure.description: Create every collection of the store that does not exist yet, from the shape it declares, and leave one that does alone. What that means is the engine's: nothing at all, for one that keeps records in memory. Answers how many collections the store declares.

store.description: the path of the store document to prepare

collections.description: how many collections the store declares
